line: Uh, I’m off a Addy, I’m up I don’t got no time to relax (Time to relax, yeah)
vault_lines: I'm off a Addy, I'm up
meaning:
Addy is short for Adderall, a name brand drug usually prescribed to treat ADHD and narcolepsy. When taken as prescribed, it can improve someone’s hyperactivity and attention span.
